اغدودنا (form XII)
# اِغْدَوْدَنَا (iḡdawdanā) /iɣ.daw.da.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِغْدَوْدَنَ (iḡdawdana)
# اِغْدَوْدَنَّا (iḡdawdannā) /iɣ.daw.dan.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِغْدَوْدَنَ (iḡdawdana)
# اِغْدَوْدِنَا (iḡdawdinā) /iɣ.daw.di.naː/: second-person dual imperative of اِغْدَوْدَنَ (iḡdawdana)
